definitions.gloss: claw crane game; claw machine; UFO catcher
definitions.explanation: An arcade game where players use a joystick to maneuver a mechanical claw to grab prizes such as stuffed animals, figures, or snacks. A staple of Japanese game centers.

examples.japanese: クレーンゲームでぬいぐるみを{取|と}った。
examples.english: I won a stuffed animal from the claw machine.

examples.japanese: クレーンゲームに{千円|せんえん}も{使|つか}ってしまった。
examples.english: I ended up spending a thousand yen on the claw machine.

examples.japanese: ゲームセンターのクレーンゲームで{限定|げんてい}フィギュアを{狙|ねら}って{何度|なんど}も{挑戦|ちょうせん}した。
examples.english: I tried many times to get a limited-edition figure from the claw machine at the game center.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Extremely popular in Japan, where game centers (ゲームセンター) often dedicate entire floors to claw machines. The brand name UFOキャッチャー (UFO Catcher, by SEGA) is often used as a generic term. Prizes range from plush toys to high-end figures, snacks, and even electronics. Staff can sometimes reposition prizes if a customer has spent enough.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クレーンゲームで{遊|あそ}ぶ (to play the claw machine)
- クレーンゲームの{景品|けいひん} (claw machine prizes)
- クレーンゲームに{挑戦|ちょうせん}する (to try the claw machine)

WRITING:
Also called UFOキャッチャー (brand name) or simply クレゲー in casual speech.
